kjv: God standeth in the congregation of the mighty
mine: God has taken His place in the divine council
note: ba'adat-'el "in the assembly of El", the heavenly council of the gods (cf. 89:6-8), over whom God pronounces judgment (vv.6-7); "congregation of the mighty" lets the reader take them as human rulers, the reading Jesus' argument in Jn 10:34 also allows.
